purpose: Define the immutable identity object used to carry external regulatory programs across SCENIC+, NIH-CARD Stage 4, Morabito, SEA-AD multiome, perturbation, spatial and FULL104 transport.
identity_rules: program_id identifies a biological/regulatory program family; program_version changes whenever membership or region identity changes
membership_sha256 is calculated from canonical sorted TF, gene and region memberships and therefore changes on any membership mutation
region_build is mandatory whenever region_ids is non-empty
liftover never mutates the original program version; converted coordinates are a derived mapping artifact with its own receipt
ambiguous gene or TF identifiers remain unresolved rather than guessed
Route-A submitted-peak and Route-B fragment-reconstructed networks are distinct definition_source values even if later judged biologically concordant
Stage-4 outcomes, Morabito outcomes, perturbation outcomes and recoverability TEST may not alter program membership after freeze

lines: TF=<sorted stable TF identifiers, comma separated>
GENE=<sorted stable target gene identifiers, comma separated>
REGION=<sorted canonical region strings, comma separated>
canonical_membership_serialization.sha256_role: membership identity only; not a claim of biological validity

forbidden: changing membership after protected validation outcomes are inspected without creating a new version
using Stage-4 Delta/LCB/p-value to define or prune membership
using Morabito agreement to define or prune membership
using perturbation outcome agreement to define or prune membership
pooling distinct source-specific program definitions and calling them one frozen network without an explicit reconciliation artifact
